_comment: Copy to .claude/wt.config.json and adjust. Every key is optional; defaults shown. Used only when worktree mode is on (CLAUDE.md, Профиль проекта).
_worktree_root: Where worktrees are created. null = sibling folder <repo>-worktrees. Keep it OUTSIDE cloud-synced folders (OneDrive/YandexDisk/Dropbox). Env WT_ROOT overrides.
_env_file: Env file copied into each tree; if it holds a Postgres DATABASE_URL the tree gets its own database, REDIS_DB and rewritten FRONTEND_URL/CORS_ORIGINS ports. Example for a split repo: backend/.env
_venv_dir: Python venv with asyncpg, used only for CREATE/DROP DATABASE. Example: backend/.venv
_local_artifacts: Gitignored things a fresh tree needs: junction = link to the main repo copy (no reinstall), copy = real copy. Missing paths are skipped. Example: [["frontend/node_modules","junction"],["backend/.venv","junction"],["backend/.env","copy"]]
_ports: Slot N (1..9) gets base + stride*N; slot 0 is the main repo.
